verdict.rationale: Brave Search API is a pure HTTP API. You get an API key and call endpoints directly, as the curl example to the local descriptions endpoint shows, so it is inherently headless and scriptable. Automation is supported through an official n8n community node, the official MCP server and OpenAI-SDK-compatible answers. However, nothing documents CI pipelines specifically, and probes found no OpenAPI spec for generating clients. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage guidance (e.g. secrets handling or pipeline examples), an official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated/CI use.
